grammarFocus: 原因、结果与让步从句；may / might / can 的语气差别。
title: Week 23 Listening: Lifestyle Choices and Opinions
instructions: 本材料为模拟练习，非官方雅思试题。听录音前先阅读题目，听录音时注意说话人的语气和原因、结果、让步从句。录音播放两遍。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Tom. You look tired. Are you okay?
Tom: Yeah, I’m fine. I just came back from the gym. I’m trying to exercise more because I sit at a desk all day.
Mia: That’s good. I might start yoga, but I’m not sure. I heard it’s good for stress.
Tom: You should try it. My sister does yoga every morning, and she says it helps her focus. But it can be expensive if you go to a studio.
Mia: Right. I could do it at home with videos. That might be cheaper.
Tom: Exactly. So, what about your diet? Are you eating healthier now?
Mia: Well, I try to eat more vegetables, but I still eat too much sugar. I know it’s bad for me, but I love chocolate.
Tom: I understand. I used to drink soda every day, but I stopped because my doctor told me to. Now I drink water or tea.
Mia: That’s impressive. I can’t give up chocolate. Maybe I can reduce it, though.
Tom: That’s a good start. Small changes are easier to keep.
Mia: By the way, did you see the news about the new park? They’re going to build it near our office.
Tom: Yes, I read about it. I think it’s a great idea because we need more green spaces. But some people disagree. They say it will be noisy and crowded.
Mia: I can see their point, but I still support the park. It might encourage people to walk more.
Tom: True. Although it may take a year to finish, I think it’s worth it.
Mia: Me too. So, are you going to the gym again tomorrow?
Tom: I might. It depends on how I feel. But I can go with you if you want to try yoga.
Mia: Really? That would be great. But I’m not very flexible.
Tom: Don’t worry. Everyone starts somewhere. You can borrow my sister’s mat if you like.
Mia: Thanks! I’ll think about it. I may join you next week.

questions.prompt: Why is Tom trying to exercise more?
options: Because he sits at a desk all day.
Because he wants to lose weight.
Because his doctor told him to.
answers: Because he sits at a desk all day.
questions.explanation: Tom说“I’m trying to exercise more because I sit at a desk all day.”，直接给出原因。
questions.evidence: I’m trying to exercise more because I sit at a desk all day.

questions.prompt: What does Mia say about yoga?
options: She might start yoga but is not sure.
She does yoga every morning.
She thinks yoga is too expensive.
answers: She might start yoga but is not sure.
questions.explanation: Mia说“I might start yoga, but I’m not sure.”，表明她可能开始但不确定。
questions.evidence: I might start yoga, but I’m not sure.

questions.prompt: Tom’s sister says yoga helps her ______.
questions.explanation: Tom提到“she says it helps her focus”，因此填focus。
questions.evidence: she says it helps her focus

questions.prompt: What does Mia still eat too much of?
options: Vegetables
Sugar
Soda
questions.explanation: Mia说“I still eat too much sugar.”，直接说明她仍然吃太多糖。
questions.evidence: I still eat too much sugar.

questions.prompt: Why did Tom stop drinking soda?
options: Because his doctor told him to.
Because he prefers water.
Because it is expensive.
answers: Because his doctor told him to.
questions.explanation: Tom说“I stopped because my doctor told me to.”，原因是医生建议。
questions.evidence: I stopped because my doctor told me to.

questions.prompt: What is Tom’s opinion about the new park?
options: He thinks it’s a great idea.
He thinks it will be noisy.
He disagrees with it.
answers: He thinks it’s a great idea.
questions.explanation: Tom说“I think it’s a great idea because we need more green spaces.”，明确支持。
questions.evidence: I think it’s a great idea because we need more green spaces.

questions.prompt: Why do some people disagree with the park?
options: They say it will be noisy and crowded.
They say it will cost too much.
They say it will take too long to build.
answers: They say it will be noisy and crowded.
questions.explanation: Tom说“They say it will be noisy and crowded.”，这是反对者的理由。
questions.evidence: They say it will be noisy and crowded.

questions.prompt: What does Mia think the park might do?
options: Encourage people to walk more.
Make the office quieter.
Reduce pollution.
questions.explanation: Mia说“It might encourage people to walk more.”，这是她的看法。
questions.evidence: It might encourage people to walk more.

questions.prompt: How long may it take to finish the park?
options: A year
Two years
Six months
questions.explanation: Tom说“it may take a year to finish”，因此是a year。
questions.evidence: it may take a year to finish

questions.prompt: What does Tom offer to do?
options: Go with Mia to try yoga.
Give Mia his sister’s mat.
Join a gym with Mia.
answers: Go with Mia to try yoga.
questions.explanation: Tom说“I can go with you if you want to try yoga.”，他提出一起去尝试瑜伽。
questions.evidence: I can go with you if you want to try yoga.

vocabulary.example: I just came back from the gym.
I heard it’s good for stress.
she says it helps her focus
Maybe I can reduce it, though.
It might encourage people to walk more.

grammar.title: 原因、结果与让步从句；may / might / can 的语气差别
grammar.explanation: 原因从句用 because 说明理由；结果从句用 so 引出结果；让步从句用 although / though 表示“虽然”。may 和 might 表示“可能”，语气较不确定，might 更弱；can 表示“能够”或“可以”，语气更肯定。
grammar.example: I might start yoga, but I’m not sure. / I can go with you if you want to try yoga.

options: I stayed home because it was raining.
I stayed home because it was rain.
I stayed home because of it was raining.
answers: I stayed home because it was raining.
questions.explanation: because 后接完整句子，说明原因。
questions.evidence: I’m trying to exercise more because I sit at a desk all day.

options: She was tired, so she went to bed early.
She was tired, so she go to bed early.
She was tired, because she went to bed early.
answers: She was tired, so she went to bed early.
questions.explanation: so 引出结果，前后时态一致。
questions.evidence: I stopped because my doctor told me to.

options: Although it was cold, we went for a walk.
Although it was cold, but we went for a walk.
Although it was cold, so we went for a walk.
answers: Although it was cold, we went for a walk.
questions.explanation: although 表示让步，不能与 but 或 so 连用。
questions.evidence: Although it may take a year to finish, I think it’s worth it.

options: I might go to the party, but I’m not sure.
I might go to the party, but I’m not sure can.
I can go to the party, but I’m not sure might.
answers: I might go to the party, but I’m not sure.
questions.explanation: might 表示不确定的可能性，符合语境。
questions.evidence: I might start yoga, but I’m not sure.

part1: Do you prefer to exercise alone or with others?
What do you do to stay healthy?
Do you think parks are important in cities?
Have you ever tried yoga or another form of exercise?
speaking.part2: Describe a healthy habit you would like to start. You should say: what the habit is; why you want to start it; how you might do it; and explain how it could change your life.
part3: Why do some people find it hard to keep healthy habits?
Should governments encourage people to exercise more? How?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of building new parks in cities?
Do you think people today are more or less healthy than in the past?

transfer.writing: Write an email to a friend (about 120 words) suggesting a healthy activity you could do together. Explain why you want to try it, how you might start, and what the possible benefits are. Use because, so, although, and may/might/can.
